desc: The Armaspec Classic charging handle offers many of the great features found in Armaspec's premium Victory model, but at a more budget-friendly price point. By removing the integrated gas ports and hollow levers, they've crafted an affordable yet efficient charging handle. The Armaspec Classic still boasts ambidextrous curved handles and the use of their center force charging mechanism to minimize shaft twisting, all while prioritizing affordability for their valued customers.
